changelog: v1.1.6 - Attendance Live Notification now requests Android 16's official promoted/Live Update treatment, and shows a final "Work completed" summary on punch-out
features: Attendance notification now requests Android 16's formal Live Update (promoted ongoing) treatment, on top of the Samsung/Android compact pill it already had
Punching out now leaves a one-time "Work completed" summary (punch-in time and hours worked) instead of just clearing the notification
Attendance notification now uses Android's own Live Notification pill (Samsung's "Live notifications") instead of a custom card - drawn by the system itself, with a live chronometer
Push notifications now always show in the notification tray, even while the app is open - not just as an in-app banner
Update check no longer re-downloads an already-downloaded version if you close the sheet before installing
